# Nebula Classroom

> A fully equipped classroom for rent in the center of Tetovo, North Macedonia. Teachers and trainers book it by the day, the week or the month, or take it exclusively for a month. Booking requests are made on the website and confirmed by phone; prices are given per request.

- Address: Rr. 19 Nëntori, Kompleksi Lovec, 1200 Tetovë, North Macedonia
- Phone: +389 75 281 813, +389 70 470 555
- Email: nebulacoworkinspace@gmail.com
- Hours: every day, 08:00–22:00
- Equipment: fast WiFi, air conditioning, TV and whiteboard, desks and chairs, bathroom and kitchen, city parking nearby
- Used for: language courses (English, German, Albanian, Macedonian), private tutoring, workshops and trainings, teaching online
- Languages: Albanian, Macedonian, English
- Formerly known as Nebula Co-Working Space
